content_sections.heading: Tezpur University Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 3 vacancies are available - 2 for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and 1 for Senior Research Fellow (SRF).

content_sections.heading: Tezpur University Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M.E./ M.Tech./ M.S./ M.Sc./ MCA/ B.E./ B.Tech. or equivalent degree in Computer Science and Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biotechnology, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Life Sciences, or a closely related discipline. Valid CSIR/ UGC NET (including Assistant Professorship)/ GATE or qualified in National Level Examination conducted by Govt. agencies such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. or qualified in Category-II merit list of DBT-BET examination. Senior Research Fellow (SRF): Qualification prescribed for JRF with two years of research experience.

content_sections.heading: Tezpur University Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 32 years for all posts. Upper age limit may be relaxed as per the Government of India rules. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Tezpur University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Tezpur University recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Tezpur University Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Senior Research Fellow (SRF) posts is 04 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for JRF and SRF posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies, with 2 for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and 1 for Senior Research Fellow (SRF).

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: For JRF, candidates need a Master's degree in relevant disciplines and a valid CSIR/UGC NET/GATE qualification. For SRF, the same qualification is required along with two years of research experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Tezpur University recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the JRF and SRF positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for both Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Senior Research Fellow (SRF) positions is 32 years, with relaxation applicable as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is Rs. 37,000 + HRA per month, and for Senior Research Fellow (SRF), it is Rs. 42,000 + HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply by sending their complete application with all required documents via email before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Tezpur University recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of applications, followed by a personal interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Tezpur University located?
faq.answer: Tezpur University is located in Tezpur, Assam, with the pincode 784028.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a B.E./B.Tech. degree apply?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with a B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent degree in relevant disciplines are eligible to apply for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position, provided they meet other criteria.
